QuestInfo.name: An Engineer's Dream
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2300003##k, the Veritas engineer, wants to see you.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p2300003##k is the #m230050000# engineer. He created the ship, <Promessa>.
Unfortunately, it sounds like he used up all of their parts and budget to do it. Go hunt #b#o2400013##k and #b#o2400014##k robots in #m400000000# and bring back #b50 #t4000711##k and #b#t4000712##k items to replenish their inventory.

Take Promessa to #b#m400000000##k. #o2400013# is in
the #b#m400030400##k,and #o2400014# is in
the #b#m400010400##k.
QuestInfo.2: You got all the parts for #p2300003#. He's got a weird twinkle in his eye though...

0.0: You the newbie? That's cool, I'm sort of like THE dude around here, you know? If you're cool with me, you can even get up on my ride. I call it... #b<Promessa>#k!
0.1: This thing can travel on the water, the ground, uh, the AIR! It is like THE best.
0.2: Except... I kinda spent our whole year's operating budget getting it up and running. But come on, HID headlights!\r\n#p2300001#'s always going on and on about\r\nbeing responsible and documenting how stuff gets made, but I build with PASSION.
0.3: So anyway, you think you could maybe get me some\r\n#bmaterials#k? I'll let you roll on Promessa whenever you\r\nwant.

yes.0: I knew we were cool! There's these beasties with really tough shells in Grandis, they call 'em the #b#o2400014##k and the #b#o2400013##k. Go get some stuff from them. I bet it'll be perfect for tricking out Promessa... and the lab I guess.

no.0: Man, you're nothing but a square-bot.

1.0: Did you bring those materials? Dreamboat's all over my case.

yes.0: Great! I actually only needed 30 of each, but I'm gonna do something awesome with those extras.

item.0: Hey, you don't have the materials! To get to Grandis, take the Promessa to #b#m400000000##k. Go to #b#m400030400##k and #b#m400010400##k afterwards to find those monsters.
